clips.title: The story
paras: South of the Crossroads, Lushwater Oasis is one of three life-giving watering holes in the Barrens. Kolkar centaur threaten travelers who come for its water, while the tainted pools draw anglers seeking Deviate Fish.

Lushwater Oasis lies a short march south of the Crossroads, beneath the Barrens sun. Its palms and springs draw thirsty beasts, but Kolkar centaur hold the banks and ambush wildlife and travelers. The oasis also marks the entrance to the Wailing Caverns. Energies from its underground passages taint the pools, where unnatural creatures and strange mutations take hold.
